newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS FRIDAY STABLE IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS FRIDAY STABLE IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Friday's trading session predictably stable at its opening levels in a quiet market, but foreign exchange dealers expect it to swing gently in narrow ranges next week on improved business.

"There was little business today because many people are still out on holiday. We are expecting activity and volumes to improve somewhat next week, and that should leave the (Zimbabwe) dollar on a gentle swing," one dealer said.

The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 10.8100/8300 against the U.S. dollar from its pre-Christmas rate of 10.8000/8200. It was traded slightly weaker at 2.3100/3300 against the South African rand, down from 2.3000/3200, and at 6.9600/9700 from 6.9500/9700 against the German mark.
The local currency -- which closed at 18.1000/1500 on pound sterling on Christmas Eve -- ended Friday at 18.1000/1200, the level at which it started the day.
